title: OpenAI 將推出「AI 抖音」：禁止上傳實拍內容，Sora 2 加持
content: OpenAI is preparing to launch a new AI-powered short-video social app, likened to TikTok but with 100% AI-generated content, according to a report by TechNews. The app, rumored to be called Sora 2, will feature a vertical feed, swipe navigation, 'For You' recommendations, likes, comments, and a unique 'Remix' function. Users will only be able to generate videos up to 10 seconds long using the next-generation Sora 2 model, and the app will not allow uploads from personal galleries or other apps, ensuring all content is AI-generated. The platform includes identity verification to enable users to generate digital avatars, which others can tag in their videos—such as placing a user’s likeness in a fictional scene like a theme park ride. Notifications will alert users whenever their digital likeness is used, even in unpublished drafts. The app has already been internally tested at OpenAI, receiving overwhelmingly positive feedback from employees, with concerns about potential productivity loss due to addictive use. This move aligns with OpenAI’s broader strategy to build an AI-driven, all-in-one digital gateway, integrating commerce, content creation, social interaction, and productivity. The company recently introduced 'Instant Checkout' in ChatGPT, a feature developed with Stripe, enabling users to purchase products directly within conversations—powered by the open-source 'Agentic Commerce Protocol'. Competitors like Meta (with Vibes) and Google (with Veo 3 on YouTube) are also entering the AI video space, but OpenAI’s vision centers on unifying diverse digital functions under a single AI interface. The launch is expected within the next few weeks, initially available only to Pro users, reflecting OpenAI’s focus on compute-intensive AI products.

title: OpenAI and the race for AI-driven commerce | TechCrunch
content: OpenAI unveiled its strategy for AI-driven commerce during its annual DevDay on October 7, 2025, demonstrating how apps like Spotify, Figma, Uber, Expedia, Instacart, DoorDash, Target, and others can be integrated directly into ChatGPT, enabling users to perform actions such as booking trips, ordering food, or calling services without leaving the interface. This marks a pivotal step toward an AI-first internet, where ChatGPT functions as a central hub for both customer discovery and retail transactions. OpenAI has already launched Instant Checkout, a payment infrastructure supporting Shopify, Etsy, and Stripe, enabling one-off purchases. With this ecosystem, OpenAI positions ChatGPT as a super-aggregator—potentially capturing a share of every transaction, much like an app store. The company’s vision extends beyond passive product search: AI agents could initiate purchases (e.g., buying concert tickets as soon as they go on sale) or negotiate deals. Competitors such as Google (with AP2 protocol), Adobe (predicting AI-assisted shopping will dominate the 2025 holiday season), and Mastercard (calling agentic commerce a 'new competitive arena') are also investing heavily. Despite strong backing from tech firms and financial institutions, user adoption remains uncertain, as fully functional agentic shopping systems are not yet available to the average consumer. The success of this model hinges on future user acceptance, with significant implications for OpenAI, retailers, and the broader tech industry.

title: OpenAI发布GPT-5，AI应用降价或迎来普惠时代
content: OpenAI has released GPT-5, with a new API pricing system that has sparked market attention. The updated pricing is $1.25 per million tokens, a 20% decrease from the previous version O3. This price drop is not only a sign of the further popularization of AI technology, but also the expectation of the 'AI democratization era'. In recent years, the trend of cost reduction in AI large model technology has become increasingly evident, driven by technological progress, economies of scale, and market competition. As a result, the cost of operation has been significantly reduced, and the overall business efficiency has been improved. Professional analysts point out that this trend will significantly increase the adoption rate of large models in enterprises, making them a core production tool for modern enterprises. The price drop of large models will have a positive impact on the development of various industries. Firstly, it will pave the way for the large-scale application of intelligent agents, promoting the popularization of multi-modal deep thinking functions in customer service, data analysis, and other fields. At the same time, the price drop will significantly lower the threshold for enterprises to apply AI, enabling the widespread explosion of AI applications in various industries. With the promotion of AI towards democratization, investment opportunities in the market are also emerging. Many institutions believe that, under the background of cost reduction and efficiency improvement, domestic large models, combined with national policy support, will drive the rapid popularization of new-generation intelligent terminals, such as AI phones and PCs, smart networked new energy vehicles, and intelligent robots. The upstream computing resources and downstream terminal and application companies will also benefit significantly. Currently, China's artificial intelligence industry is in a stage of rapid development, with AI+ application products emerging in large numbers. For example, the number of generative AI patents in China reached 27,000 in 2024, accounting for 61.5% of the global total, ranking first in the world. According to the 'China Internet Development Status Statistical Report', China's artificial intelligence industry scale is expected to break through 700 billion yuan in 2024, with a growth rate of over 20% for several consecutive years. According to the research of iResearch, China's artificial intelligence market size is expected to reach 81.1 billion yuan by 2028. For investors interested in AI, they can focus on the science and technology innovation board AI ETF (588930) and its connected fund (A-class: 023550, C-class: 023551, I-class: 023552). This fund tracks the science and technology innovation board's 30 emerging leaders in the AI industry, providing a convenient investment channel for investors to share the benefits of the AI democratization era. In this round of AI technology development wave, the active layout of various investment institutions and enterprises will have a profound impact on the future market landscape.

title: OpenAI: Latest news and insights
content: OpenAI, the artificial intelligence organization comprising the non-profit OpenAI, Inc. and its for-profit subsidiaries, continues to dominate tech news with frequent product launches, strategic partnerships, and legal challenges. Key developments in 2025 include the announcement of GPT-5 on August 7, 2025, described as 'smarter, sharper, and built for the real world'; the release of the o3-pro model with an 80% price reduction on June 18, 2025; and the acquisition of AI coding tool Windsurf for $3 billion on May 6, 2025, later derailed by Google's $2.4 billion acquisition of Windsurf executives. OpenAI also launched the o3-mini reasoning model on January 31, 2025, and introduced the Operator AI agent for web task automation on January 24, 2025. The company has entered into a major five-year computing power commitment with Oracle, valued at $300 billion, and secured a 4.5GW data center expansion in Texas. OpenAI has faced ongoing legal scrutiny, including a countersuit against Elon Musk over a $97 billion acquisition offer, and a lawsuit from Indian media outlets over copyright infringement. In April 2025, OpenAI admitted that AI hallucinations are mathematically inevitable, not merely engineering flaws. The company has also shifted its governance structure, reaffirming its nonprofit foundation while scaling back changes. Microsoft remains a key partner, though tensions persist over control and contracts, with Microsoft developing its own AI models to compete. OpenAI's strategic moves include launching Apache-licensed GPT-OSS models on August 6, 2025, and expanding its AI roadmap to integrate models like o3 into GPT-5. The company has also announced plans for a productivity suite and deep research agents, while facing criticism over speed vs. safety trade-offs and data privacy concerns, including a conflict with Indian data deletion demands. OpenAI’s leadership, including Sam Altman, maintains that AGI has not yet been achieved, despite claims from some reports that o3 reached AGI in January 2025.

title: OpenAI开发者大会即将开幕：奥特曼与艾维对话，AI浏览器要来了？
content: OpenAI is set to host its third annual Developer Day 2025 (DevDay 2025) on Monday, October 6, 2025, at the Masonic Center in San Francisco, with over 1,500 attendees expected. The event will feature a keynote speech by CEO Sam Altman, who will unveil major announcements, conduct live demonstrations, and present a vision for how developers can use AI to reshape the future. A highlight of the event will be a live 'fireside chat' between Altman and Jony Ive, former senior design director at Apple, on the philosophy of creation in the AI era, scheduled for 4:15 PM Pacific Time (1:15 AM Beijing Time on October 7). The event will also include interactive AI experiences, such as the 'Sora Cinema' showcasing short films generated by OpenAI's Sora video model and a phone booth featuring an AI-powered dynamic portrait of Alan Turing, enabling real-time conversations with visitors. While no specific product releases have been confirmed, speculation is high that OpenAI may announce its long-anticipated AI browser or progress on AI hardware developed in collaboration with Ive and former Apple executives. The 'State of the Union' session, led by OpenAI President Greg Brockman and Platform Product Lead Olivier Godement, will follow at 3:15 PM PT, focusing on new developer features and future roadmaps. The keynote and all sessions will be streamed live on OpenAI’s official YouTube channel.

title: 【上证计算机】海内外AI进展不停，算力需求持续景气 -- -- 近期重要AI事件汇总
content: OpenAI held its DevDay 2025 on October 6, 2025, unveiling significant advancements in AI technology, including the release of Sora 2, a next-generation video generation model, and the AI video social app 'Sora,' currently accessible via invite code. Sora 2 demonstrates notable improvements in physical logic, visual consistency, and realism, enabling users to generate 10-second narrative videos from a single image and text prompt. The event also featured the transformation of ChatGPT into a 'super app' capable of integrating third-party applications directly within conversations, the launch of AgentKit for developers to lower AI application development barriers, the full public release of Codex with enhanced features, and an upgraded API offering access to GPT-5 Pro and Sora 2. OpenAI announced a strategic partnership with AMD to deploy 6 GW of AMD GPU compute capacity, with the first 1 GW of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs scheduled for deployment in the second half of 2026. Domestically, China's large AI models continue to flourish: Alibaba launched six new models and the Qwen3-Max flagship model at the Cloud Computing Conference on September 24, claiming performance surpassing GPT-5 and Claude Opus 4, placing it among the world’s top three. DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp on September 29, featuring a sparse attention mechanism for improved long-text efficiency, with API pricing reduced by up to 83% and compatibility confirmed with Cambricon and Ascend. Kuaishou introduced the Keling 2.5 Turbo model, improving video output quality while lowering prices by 30%. Zhipu AI launched GLM-4.6, which matches Claude Sonnet 4 in advanced coding tasks. Ant Group open-sourced Ring-1T-preview (Ling 2.0), the world’s first trillion-parameter open-source reasoning model. Tencent released Hunyuan Image 3.0 on September 28, the first industrial-grade native multimodal image generation model (80B parameters), which achieved top performance on LMArena, surpassing 26 global models and matching leading proprietary models. The current version only supports text-to-image generation, with image-to-image, editing, and multi-turn interaction features to follow. The report, published by Shanghai Securities Co., Ltd. on October 9, 2025, highlights sustained AI-driven compute demand, with risks including lower-than-expected downstream demand, slower policy implementation, technological innovation delays, and intensified industry competition.

title: Redefining AI Evaluation: OpenAI's Shift to Real-World Performance Metrics
content: OpenAI has introduced a new evaluation framework called GDPval at OpenAI DevDay [2025], shifting focus from traditional academic benchmarks to real-world, economically valuable tasks. Led by Tejal Patwardhan of OpenAI's Reinforcement Learning team, the initiative addresses the limitations of past evaluations like the SAT or AIME, which could yield near-perfect scores without reflecting practical utility. GDPval measures AI performance on long-horizon, multimodal tasks—such as designing a real estate brochure, creating a 3D model of a cable reel stand, or editing a high-energy video intro—selected from the top nine U.S. GDP-contributing sectors and their top five knowledge work occupations. Over a thousand such tasks were curated with input from experts averaging 14 years of experience. Evaluation uses pairwise expert grading, where blinded human experts compare model outputs to human expert deliverables, generating a 'win rate'—the percentage of times the model’s output is preferred or equally good. Data shows GPT-4o achieved less than 20% win rate, while GPT-5 high is nearing 40%, indicating rapid progress toward human-level performance on real-world tasks. Henry Scott-Green, OpenAI's Evals Product Lead, emphasized that rigorous evaluations are critical for building reliable AI applications, especially agents, due to non-determinism, endless edge cases, and high user expectations in regulated domains. OpenAI’s Evals product provides tools for visual eval building, trace grading, automated prompt optimization, third-party model support via OpenRouter, and enterprise-grade security with zero data retention and key management. The framework underscores that systematic, real-world evaluation is essential for translating AI capabilities into tangible economic value.

title: OpenAI, yapay zeka odaklı sosyal medya uygulamasını tanıttı
content: OpenAI has introduced Sora 2, a new AI-powered social media application featuring the 'Cameolar' function, which allows users to insert themselves as characters into AI-generated video content. The feature enables users to upload a short video and audio clip to create a personalized digital avatar, or 'Cameo,' that can be integrated into any Sora scene with high realism. Sora 2 is described as the flagship video and audio system, capable of generating realistic visuals, synchronized sound effects, and physics-consistent dynamics in videos. According to OpenAI, Sora 2 supports longer, coherent storylines and produces both video and audio content, including sound effects. Users retain full control over their digital identity, including who can use their Cameo and the ability to revoke access or delete videos at any time. The platform also allows users to view all videos containing their Cameo, including drafts created by others. OpenAI emphasizes that all generated content is labeled as 'AI generated' and includes a Sora watermark when exported. The company also announced a redesigned Sora.com website with an updated storyboard interface and the launch of a dedicated API. Users in the U.S. and Canada on the waitlist can now invite friends via invitations. The company highlighted that Cameolar enhances interaction and offers a new way to connect with friends, with customizable content feeds prioritizing preferred themes such as relaxing or animal videos. The announcement was made in a blog post featuring Sam Altman and included sample videos demonstrating the technology's capabilities.

title: 올트먼 "AI는 이제 스스로 행동하는 존재" - 매일경제
content: At the OpenAI DevDay 2025 event held on October 6, 2025, at Fort Mason in San Francisco, Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, declared the dawn of an 'age where AI acts independently,' stating that 'AI is no longer just answering questions but is now changing the world on its own.' The company unveiled several new products and models, including GPT-5 Pro, GPT Real-Time Mini, and the Sorra 2 API. Altman described GPT-5 Pro as 'the most intelligent and deepest model we've ever built,' emphasizing enhanced agent control and end-to-end coding capabilities. He stated that GPT-5 Pro will serve as a 'thinking partner' for developers, marking a shift where code is co-created with AI rather than solely written by humans. GPT-5 Pro was made available via API to developers worldwide, with startups like Cursor and WindSurf already using it to drastically accelerate development workflows. OpenAI also introduced GPT Real-Time Mini, a compact version of its high-end voice model that maintains the same quality but at 70% lower cost. Altman emphasized that 'voice will become the primary way people interact with AI,' predicting that AI conversations will soon feel as natural as human dialogue. The Sorra 2 API, also unveiled, was described by Altman as a model that 'gives AI the ability to directly stage the world for the first time,' capable of generating cinematic, detailed scenes that maintain state and context. It can expand short smartphone videos into cinematic wide shots. The toy company Mattel was the first to test Sorra 2 API, using it to convert hand-drawn sketches into 3D product mockups with color and material in minutes instead of weeks. Altman concluded that 'AI is accelerating creativity to the speed of human thought,' enabling anyone to instantly materialize ideas. He also announced that 'we are now entering an era where AI builds AI,' forecasting a future where AI teams collaborate with developers, replacing individual coding efforts.

title: Semana IA | OpenAI, la invasión de los agentes - ON ECONOMIA
content: OpenAI unveiled three major AI agent innovations during its Dev Day on October 12, 2025: Apps SDK, AgentKit, and Codex, alongside updates to Sora 2 and GPT-5 Pro for developers. Apps SDK enables ChatGPT to interact directly with applications—such as booking hotels on Booking.com or querying Coursera courses—potentially transforming how users shop, learn, and navigate digital services. AgentKit offers developers a tool to build agents with Python integration, though its interface remains less intuitive than expected. Codex, OpenAI’s programming agent, has advanced rapidly and may soon surpass Cursor, its main competitor. These developments reflect OpenAI’s dual vision: creating personal and professional AI agents and advancing toward a universal scientific agent. The progress stems from transformer architecture and the breakthrough o1 model, which enables real-time reasoning. OpenAI has also secured unprecedented computing infrastructure and achieved autonomous code generation. Meanwhile, Figure AI launched Figure 03, a 1.68-meter-tall robot capable of handling household tasks and working up to five hours, powered by the Helix multimodal language model. Google countered with Gemini Enterprise, a no-code AI platform for enterprises integrating with Box, Microsoft 365, and Salesforce, featuring Model Armor for data security. In parallel, Samsung SAIL Montréal introduced Tiny Recursive Model (TRM), a lightweight AI with only seven million parameters that outperforms larger models like DeepSeek and Gemini in complex tasks such as Sudoku and maze-solving, proving that efficiency and reasoning matter more than scale. The AI race continues to evolve across agents, robotics, and foundational models.
